title: Handoff Envelope
description: Every inter-agent message carries this. Enforced by validate_envelope() in bin/wf.py — an envelope that fails is refused and logged, never partially applied.

agent.description: slug from agents/, must match the station owner in stations.json

action.description: verb_noun. Substring-matched against GATED_ACTIONS — an action containing pay/sign/publish/file_gov/commit_spend/file_dispute_as_client gates automatically.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omitted means derived from station+entity+action+payload digest. Supply explicitly when the same logical action could be composed from differing payloads (e.g. a retry with a corrected typo that must NOT re-send).

payload.description: Merged into the entity file on commit. Shape is governed by the station's output contract.

derived_from.description: Entity ids, file paths, call ids, or URLs. A number with no source here is a refusal, not a guess.

confidence.description: Below 0.6 on a money or external-facing figure must escalate rather than commit.

requires.description: Agent-declared gate. The runtime also gates independently on action name — an agent cannot opt out by omitting this.
